question: What is the meaning of life cycle assessment (lca) environmental in relation to chemical properties?
description: Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) environmental analysis focuses on evaluating the potential environmental impacts of a product system throughout its life cycle. This includes assessing the effects of chemical properties on human health and ecosystems. However, due to the lack of broad consensus and harmonization in the LCA community, there is no clear guidance on how to achieve this in practice, and many LCA practitioners exclude toxicity-related impacts. Therefore, the meaning of LCA environmental in relation to chemical properties is not explicitly defined in the provided text.
